response.rationale: Reach z-score of 6.36 (~6.4 baseline sigmas) is a severe, clearly flagged surge. CPM is essentially flat (z=-0.81, unflagged), so this is not a price/bidding-war effect, and the own-action confound flag is False, so it is unlikely the harness's own prior bid/budget change showing up in the data. The pattern — large reach expansion with no accompanying price pressure and no self-inflicted cause — points to a genuine market signal (query-volume/demand surge or competitor easing opening up cheap impressions), which warrants a reaction.
